answer: Because the timing is recorded against the vault challenge, the tide audit can replay the prism history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 362 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A scripted farm thus has to pad 148 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
